# scrutari_tenant (Data Source)

The tenant owned by the authenticated API key. There is no `id` lookup parameter — the gateway's tenant-isolation discipline (Task #54) means each key is scoped to exactly one tenant, so the data source returns that tenant unconditionally.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "scrutari_tenant" "self" {}

output "current_plan" {
  value = data.scrutari_tenant.self.plan
}

output "rate_limit_rps" {
  value = data.scrutari_tenant.self.rate_limit_rps
}

output "feature_flags" {
  # `features` is a JSON-encoded string. Decode to read individual flags.
  value = jsondecode(data.scrutari_tenant.self.features)
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Read-Only

- `concurrency_cap` (Number) Maximum number of in-flight requests the gateway accepts per tenant before shedding load with `503 Service Unavailable`.
- `created_at` (String) RFC 3339 timestamp when this tenant was provisioned.
- `features` (String) JSON-encoded feature flag bag. Use `jsondecode()` in HCL to read individual flags. Unknown keys are treated as absent (false).
- `id` (String) Tenant ID slug (`tnt_<26-char-ulid>`). Stable across the tenant's lifetime.
- `name` (String) Customer-facing display name for the tenant. Set during onboarding; editable via the dashboard.
- `plan` (String) Subscription tier — one of `starter` / `growth` / `enterprise`. Drives rate-limit and concurrency caps below.
- `rate_limit_burst` (Number) Burst capacity above `rate_limit_rps` — the token-bucket depth the limiter allows before throttling kicks in.
- `rate_limit_rps` (Number) Steady-state request-rate cap (requests/second) the gateway enforces for this tenant. Set by the plan tier.
- `updated_at` (String) RFC 3339 timestamp of the most recent change to the tenant row (plan tier, name, feature flags, etc.).
